rules: Aces count as 1 or 11 and face cards as 10. Place a bet, then Hit or Stand to get close to 21 without going over. A natural two-card 21 pays 3:2, ordinary wins pay 1:1, and ties return the bet. Double adds an equal bet and takes exactly one card. Split equal ranks into up to four hands; a split 21 pays as an ordinary hand. The dealer stands on all 17s, including soft 17. Highest chips wins after ten rounds or when at most one player has chips.
ui_instructions: Choose an affordable bet, then use Hit or Stand. Double and Split appear only when affordable and legal. When splitting, the active hand and every hand value/bet are shown separately. Review each hand result before Next round.

Blackjack

Aces count as 1 or 11 and face cards as 10. Place a bet, then Hit or Stand to get close to 21 without going over. A natural two-card 21 pays 3:2, ordinary wins pay 1:1, and ties return the bet. Double adds an equal bet and takes exactly one card. Split equal ranks into up to four hands; a split 21 pays as an ordinary hand. The dealer stands on all 17s, including soft 17. Highest chips wins after ten rounds or when at most one player has chips.
